gui.buff_insight.title: Buff Insight Settings
gui.buff_insight.hint: Press %s anytime · settings saved to config/buff_insight.json
gui.buff_insight.ai.desc: Generate analysis and tips via AI on hover or gain (data is sent to the configured provider); results are cached
gui.buff_insight.aiModel.desc: Model name, e.g. glm-4-flash, deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini
gui.buff_insight.aiApiKey.desc: API key from your provider console, stored locally
gui.buff_insight.displayMode.desc: Off: keep vanilla icons; Replace: this panel only; Alongside: both visible
gui.buff_insight.style.desc: Panel and icon appearance, previewed live on the right
gui.buff_insight.layout.desc: Dock the HUD panel to the left or right side of the screen
gui.buff_insight.readMode.desc: How effect data is refreshed; Hybrid is recommended
gui.buff_insight.progressBar.desc: Show a progress bar of remaining time under the name
gui.buff_insight.percentage.desc: Append the remaining percentage next to the time
gui.buff_insight.attributes.desc: Show attribute values or descriptions in the panel; off keeps rows compact
gui.buff_insight.adaptive.desc: Compress row spacing when many effects must fit on screen
gui.buff_insight.glow.desc: Whole card flashes when under 5 seconds remain
gui.buff_insight.gainSound.desc: Play a chime when gaining an effect (high for buffs, low for debuffs)
gui.buff_insight.removeFeedback.desc: Play a sound and particles when an effect ends
gui.buff_insight.particles.desc: Spawn particles around you when effects are gained or lost
gui.buff_insight.noticeSeconds.desc: How long the popup notice stays in alongside mode
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.resis: Reduces most damage taken (20% per level)
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.fire_: Immunity to fire, lava and blaze fireballs
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.water: Prevents running out of air underwater
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.invis: Renders the model invisible (gear still shows)
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.blind: Thick fog around you, unable to sprint
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.absor: Adds damage-absorbing extra hearts (+4 per level)
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.glowi: Outlines the body, visible through walls
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.luck: Better fishing treasure and loot quality
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.slow_: Falls slowly and negates fall damage
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.condu: Underwater haste, night vision and water breathing
effect.buff_insight.desc.minecraft.bad_o: Triggers a raid upon entering a village
